title: Skills catalog entry
description: Governance record for one skill. These are facts about provenance and licensing that a SKILL.md cannot state about itself, so unlike the rest of the catalog they are written by hand rather than generated. They are not duplication: nothing here is derivable from frontmatter.

name.description: Matches the skill directory and its frontmatter name, per the Agent Skills specification.

classification.description: certified: carries both positive and negative trigger cases in evals/<name>/trigger-cases.json. reference: not yet certified. Deliberately NOT a self-declaration in frontmatter — scripts/catalog.sh refuses the claim without the cases.

origin.description: Who maintains it. Kept separate from classification on purpose: a first-party skill that is not yet certified is not a community contribution, and a third-party skill can be certified.

license.description: SPDX identifier, or the name of a bundled license file. A contributed skill may be licensed differently from the collection, which is why this is per-skill.

registries.description: Registry name to the identifier this skill carries there. Empty until published.

source.description: Where a third-party skill came from. Required when origin is third-party: without an immutable revision there is no way to say what was reviewed.
